meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: Assists in writing high-quality content by conducting research, adding citations, improving hooks, iterating on outlines, and providing real-time feedback on each section. Transforms your writing process from solo effort to collaborative partnership.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把独自写作变成有人协作打磨内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写内容时经常卡壳,想要系统化研究和反馈
copy.tagline_en: Turn solo writing into a team effort with research, citations, and real-time feedback.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get stuck writing content and want structured research and feedback.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会当你的写作搭档:先帮你列大纲、查资料、补引用;你逐段写正文时,它会逐段给修改建议,还会帮你改开头钩子,最后对整篇做检查。
howto.when: 当你说要写博客、文章、教程等长内容,或把草稿贴给它做反馈、补引用、改开头时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个主题列一个文章大纲,再标出哪些部分需要找资料。
say.note: 它会生成带“研究待办”的提纲。

say.text: 这是我写的开头,帮我把钩子改得更抓人,给三个方案。
say.note: 它会先分析现状,再给多个改写选项。

say.text: 我写完了这一节,帮我审一遍并指出哪里需要补引用。
say.note: 它会逐节给反馈,列出具体修改和待补来源。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude becomes your writing partner: it helps outline, researches, and adds citations; as you write section by section, it gives section feedback, improves your hook, and does a final full-draft review.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write blog posts, articles, or tutorials, or when you paste drafts for feedback, citations, or hook improvement.

say_en.text: Turn this topic into an article outline and mark which parts need research.
say_en.note: It returns an outline with a research to-do list.

say_en.text: Here is my opening; give me three stronger hook options.
say_en.note: It analyzes the current hook, then offers alternatives.

say_en.text: I finished this section; review it and tell me where to add citations.
say_en.note: It gives section feedback with specific line edits.
